description: What is happening at a place: forecast (US NWS, MET Norway elsewhere), US weather alerts, earthquakes within 300 km in the last 7 days, England flood warnings and the Great Britain grid carbon intensity, from one lat/lon, each source with its licence. covered:false means the source does not cover the place, not all-clear. Not a safety service. $0.005 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
